text:
lia: Quick SQ from FinReg re: logging & subprocessors — they ask:
1) Do archived request logs contain full prompt text / KV cache?
2) Who can read raw logs (subprocessors)?
3) How is log data encrypted at rest?
Need concise answers I can paste into their CSQ.

samir: TL;DR before I write longer: we redact prompt/PII for long-term archives; KV cache is transient in GPU memory and not persisted to object storage; archived logs store metadata + response hashes/token counts, not full prompt strings.

irene: Encryption details: all buckets encrypted with AES-256 + KMS-managed keys. Hosted uses our KMS (customer data partitioned). For Dedicated/Private we support customer-managed CMKs (KMS/HSM) per contract. Include note about key rotation policy if they ask.

tim: Subprocessors with potential access: cloud object storage (cloud-provider), LogFlow (search/retention), SecOps (for incident triage). Access is role-based, audited, and requires a JIRA request + time-limited ephemeral creds. We do NOT share raw logs with third-party analytics without anonymization.

samir: Example redaction rules we apply during ingestion to long-term store:
```
redaction_rules:
  - pattern: '(prompt|user_input):.*'
    replace: '<REDACTED_PROMPT>'
  - pattern: 'api_key|token'
    replace: '<REDACTED_SECRET>'
```
This removes prompt text before writing to S3. Short-lived debug logs on runtime nodes can contain fragments but are access-controlled.

lia: Super helpful. If customer requires zero retention of prompts we can offer a config: no-persist + customer-side logging or Private deployment where they control keys. Also can attach SOC2/ISO artifacts.

deploy-bot: New artifact uploaded: https://files.redwood.internal/soc2/2025-SOC2-TypeII-report.pdf (access restricted to sec-engineering & legal).

irene: Also add: production support access is session-recorded and retained 90 days; all human access requires approval in the ticket and is logged in our audit system.

tim: For approvals: create a JIRA ticket tagged [data-access], include purpose, TTL, and approver (sec@redwood.com). Ops will issue ephemeral creds and record the session.

lia: Thanks — I'll draft the reply to FinReg and attach the SOC2/ISO docs. @samir @irene quick sanity check on wording before I send? :thumbsup:
